# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.3

Version 1.4.3 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.2

- **The multiplayer tells you what your router does.**
  - When the room page has no "(router port open)", players from other networks can only get in by hole punching:
    both sides send first, so that each router lets the other side in.
  - That fails when a router gives every destination its own outside port (a "symmetric" NAT). The game now asks
    two STUN servers (Google's and Cloudflare's) and compares the ports they see.
  - The room page now says, with what to do:
    - the router changes ports;
    - the outside port is only a guess (STUN did not answer);
    - no port is open.
  - What to do: turn UPnP on in the router, or forward UDP 47070 to the hosting device. "(router port open)" then
    shows.
  - A guest whose join gets no answer is told the same, in Korean too. The other refusal reasons are now in Korean
    as well.
- **Port prediction.** Routers that change ports often take the next ones. The room's punch now also goes to the 24
  ports after the guest's known one, and the guest also tries the 24 ports after the code's now and then. Some of
  these routers can then be got through without opening a port.
- **Updates retry GitHub's passing errors.** A "500"/"503" from GitHub's servers, a timeout or a cut connection is
  tried again three times, a few seconds apart, on Android and Windows (Linux already retried). The Android failure
  dialog has **다시 시도** (Try again).
- Long notices wrap onto several lines and stay on screen longer.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.3 can be in the same room.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). **For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.**

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.3-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.3-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.3-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.3-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Multiplayer unit test with two fake STUN servers: the same port from both reads as a router keeping one port; a
  different port reads as one that changes ports.
- A join that gets no answer shows the advice as a notice wrapped onto two lines (Linux screenshot).
- The Android updater code compiles. The Windows updater and multiplayer code build for 32 and 64 bits.
- All unit tests pass. No change to the decomp.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.3, versionCode 10403).

## Known limitations

- Port prediction has not been tried with real routers. Two players whose routers both change ports, with no port
  open on either side, still cannot reach each other: there is no relay server.
- The limitations of v1.4.0 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
